page.text:
Two pairs $(n_1, m_1)$ and $(n_2, m_2)$ represent the same integer when
$n_1 - m_1 = n_2 - m_2$. Since subtraction is not yet available, this is
phrased using addition alone, as $n_1 + m_2 = n_2 + m_1$. The relation so
defined is an equivalence relation on pairs of naturals.
